summary.text: David Standridge, a Republican, has represented Alabama House District 34 since December 12, 2012, and is on the November 3, 2026 general election ballot for re-election.

paragraphs.text: Before joining the House he was probate judge and commission chairman of Blount County from 2006 to 2012 and served on the Blount County School Board from 2000 to 2006.
He is a retired captain in the Blount County Sheriff's Department and attended the FBI National Academy and the Montgomery Police Academy.
He earned an associate degree from Wallace State College and an undergraduate degree in justice studies from Athens State University.
